name: 🦈Escape Tsunami for SHARKS!
desc:
🌊Welcome to Escape Tsunami for SHARKS🦈

Escape the tsunamis for Hungry shark World and Evolution Sharks! 🦈
Make sure to Upgrade your speed to be faster💨🏃‍♂️
Upgrade your Sharks to get more money! 💵💵
Upgrade your base to place more SHARKS!🏗️🔓
Get super rare mutations and games!💎🪙

Become the Richest player of all!🤑

Like the game and join the group👍👾

--UPDATE 1.2--
--Added 17 New Sharks
--Added "Apex" Rarity!👑
--Added secret cave area
--Added Rarity labels when entering different zones
--Made tsunamis spawn less
--Added Revives, TP to base, and +10 speed products
--bug fixes
Playtime, Daily, and Invite rewards coming soon 👀

--Credit to Hungry shark world and Hungry shark evolution and Ubisoft for the shark models, which were taken from sketchfab.
